title: Skin barrier
caption: Your skin barrier is the outermost layer of dead cells and lipids that sits between your body and everything outside it. When it's intact, it holds moisture in and keeps irritants out. When it's compromised — by over-exfoliating, harsh cleansers, or the UAE's constant AC cycling — it becomes porous in both directions: moisture escapes faster, irritants get in easier. That's when sensitivity, redness, and breakouts spike for no obvious reason. Knowing the barrier is the variable — not your skin 'type' — changes which products actually make sense to reach for. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
